topics.title: Stern and Simmons Tape Dispute
topics.summary: Howard Stern engages in a chaotic interaction with Richard Simmons, attempting to sell him a weight loss tape while repeatedly demanding money. The exchange escalates into physical antics involving Simmons’ hand and an extended shouting match about the tape's success and Max Alexander’s involvement.

topics.title: Phone Calls and Hollywood Squares
topics.summary: Howard Stern takes numerous phone calls during the broadcast, primarily discussing his experiences at a party and subsequent appearances on ‘Hollywood Squares.’ He recounts conversations with Richard Simmons about weight loss strategies and personal anecdotes, frequently devolving into playful arguments and attempts to engage callers in humorous discussions. The segment concludes with an exchange regarding Hollywood Squares.

topics.title: Lennon Disputes Drug History on Air
topics.summary: During the radio show, John Lennon vehemently refuted claims made in Elliot Mintz’s biography regarding his drug use from 1962-75, specifically detailing heroin and methadone experiences. He dismissed the book's portrayal as inaccurate while addressing concerns about Yoko Ono’s influence and defending his role as a father to Sean.

topics.title: John Lennon’s Sister & Sexual Anxieties
topics.summary: During a discussion about John Lennon, the hosts explore interviewing his half-sister who knew him poorly and the challenges of obtaining accurate information from unreliable sources. topics.title: Uncle Melty's Phone-In Fiasco
topics.summary: During a chaotic phone-in segment, Uncle Melty struggles to understand callers’ questions about his family and personal life, leading to bizarre tangents involving his son’s glider pilot career, complicated relationships with his mother Ray Herman, and uncomfortable inquiries regarding anatomy. The show devolves into awkward exchanges and misinterpretations.

topics.title: Footlicker Follies and Motherly Meltdowns
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, Howard discusses his mother’s unusual toilet training habits with Darren the Footlicker. Celeste joins in, revealing her own past struggles and blunt opinions about everyone involved, including Gary's perception of Darren. The conversation spirals into an uncomfortable exploration of family dynamics and personal insecurities, involving discussions on dating, perceived appearances, and childhood experiences.
